alkylation_concentration.evidence: Protein concentration was measured by a bicinchoninic acid (BCA) assay (Pierce) and proteins were reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) for 1 h at 56 °C, alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide for 1 h at RT, and diluted fourfold with 100 mM ammonium acetate at pH 8.9.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested using trypsin (sequencing-grade, Promega; 1 μg trypsin:50 μg total protein) overnight at RT.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides were enriched using phosphotyrosine immunoprecipitation and immobilized metal ion chromatography (IMAC).

dried samples were resuspended in IP buffer (100 mM Tris–HCl, 1% Nonidet P-40 at pH 7.4) and incubated with protein G agarose beads conjugated with 12 μg of anti-phospho tyrosine antibodies: 4G10 (Millipore), PY-100 (Cell Signaling Technologies), and PT-66 (Sigma) overnight at 4 °C.

instrument.evidence: interfaced with TSQ Quantum triple quadrupole mass spectrometer (Thermo Finnigan, San Jose, CA) by operating electrospray in positive ion mode and spray voltage at 28 V.

labeling.evidence: Tumors were processed and labeled with tandem-mass tag (TMT)−10-plex Mass Tag Labeling Kits (Thermo).

ptm.evidence: Cysteine carbamidomethylation, TMT-labeled lysine, and protein N-terminal were searched as fixed modifications.
Oxidized methionine, and phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine were searched as variable modifications.
